rule: One source calls the name accepted; another calls it a synonym of something else. Decided by comparing whether each source files the name as accepted or as a synonym.
Every source agrees the name is a synonym — but not of the same species. Decided by comparing the accepted species each source files the synonym under.
Nothing about this name is disputed; the species it belongs to is. Nothing on this name was compared — the doubt is carried over from its accepted species.
